purpose: Represent MG as multiple behavior-journey formulas feeding common safety, execution, and profit-room gates. Structural failure should trigger topology replacement rather than repeated threshold rescue.

normalized_inputs.ACTIVITY_WAKE: Current comparable-session activity exceeds prior same-ticker comparable-state reference.
normalized_inputs.RANGE_WAKE: Current comparable-session range exceeds prior same-ticker comparable-state reference.
normalized_inputs.PATH_WAKE: Current path improves versus prior same-ticker comparable-state reference.
normalized_inputs.UP_PATH: Current causal price path is above session reference and not below recent observed path mean.
normalized_inputs.PERSISTENCE: Observed close-to-close path contains sufficient non-down persistence over causal lookback.
normalized_inputs.ACCEPTANCE: Current close is accepted in the upper half of the current observed bar.
normalized_inputs.VALUE_EXPANSION: Current transaction value exceeds its prior causal reference.
normalized_inputs.CONSTRUCTIVE_FLOW: Observed flow resolves as buy response or sell resilience rather than ineffective effort.
normalized_inputs.FRESH_HIGH: Current bar renews the causal recent high.
normalized_inputs.EARLY_STRENGTH_RETAINED: Earlier established strength remains accepted later in the observed session.
normalized_inputs.RECOVERY_RUNNER: Prior weakness is followed by stabilization, reclaim and renewed high behavior.
normalized_inputs.LATE_LIFT: Strength appears only after weak/flat earlier state at a late session stage.
normalized_inputs.HAD_PULLBACK: A causal earlier peak-to-lower-close sequence exists before the current bar.
normalized_inputs.RECLAIM: Current close reclaims recent post-pullback closes.
normalized_inputs.RENEWED_HIGH: Current high renews the recent causal high after pullback.
normalized_inputs.STRUCTURE_LOSS: Explicit destructive lower-structure/invalidation state; never inferred from missing data.
normalized_inputs.SESSION_SAFE: Current bar belongs to an eligible governed regular-session mechanism.
normalized_inputs.DATA_COMPLETE: All mandatory inputs for the selected path are available/proven; unavailable is not zero.
normalized_inputs.EXECUTION_READY: A post-signal executable entry proxy/order state exists after the signal is known.
normalized_inputs.PROFIT_ROOM_PASS: Conservative remaining reward after realistic entry exceeds explicit round-trip friction and required safety margin.

behavior_paths.formula: ACTIVITY_WAKE AND PATH_WAKE AND UP_PATH AND PERSISTENCE AND ACCEPTANCE AND VALUE_EXPANSION AND ANTI_BUY_STALL AND NOT LATE_LIFT
behavior_paths.meaning: Ticker wakes relative to its own recent comparable state and immediately converts activity into retained upward price response.

behavior_paths.formula: RECOVERY_RUNNER AND ACCEPTANCE AND VALUE_EXPANSION AND FRESH_HIGH AND ANTI_BUY_STALL
behavior_paths.meaning: Earlier weakness is repaired causally; stabilization and reclaim culminate in renewed progress.

behavior_paths.formula: ACTIVITY_WAKE AND RANGE_WAKE AND PATH_WAKE AND UP_PATH AND ACCEPTANCE AND VALUE_EXPANSION AND FRESH_HIGH AND ANTI_BUY_STALL
behavior_paths.meaning: A previously quieter comparable state expands simultaneously in activity, range and path with fresh price progress.

behavior_paths.formula: HAD_PULLBACK AND RECLAIM AND RENEWED_HIGH AND PERSISTENCE AND ACCEPTANCE AND VALUE_EXPANSION AND ANTI_BUY_STALL
behavior_paths.meaning: An already active journey survives a causal pullback and reaccelerates rather than merely printing another green bar.

behavior_paths.formula: UP_PATH AND PERSISTENCE AND ACCEPTANCE AND VALUE_EXPANSION AND CONSTRUCTIVE_FLOW AND ANTI_BUY_STALL AND FRESH_HIGH
behavior_paths.meaning: Price progress, value and flow response remain mutually constructive; buying is not stalling and selling does not create proportional damage.

behavior_paths.formula: PATH_WAKE AND EARLY_STRENGTH_RETAINED AND PERSISTENCE AND ACCEPTANCE AND FRESH_HIGH AND ANTI_BUY_STALL AND NOT LATE_LIFT
behavior_paths.meaning: Strength was established earlier in the ticker journey, survives intervening pressure, and still renews highs.

negative_formulas.meaning: Aggressive/buy effort is not producing corresponding close/high progress.
The move is being recognized only after a weak earlier state and is treated as chase risk for MG.
Observed price journey has explicitly invalidated the retained/recovery structure.
Signal is blocked when required evidence is unavailable/unproven or the mechanism/session is ineligible.

common_gates.BEHAVIOR_PATH_OK: P01 OR P02 OR P03 OR P04 OR P05 OR P06
common_gates.TRAP_FREE: NOT (N01 OR N02 OR N03 OR N04)

execution_contract.signal_entry_separation: Signal knowledge occurs first. Historical execution evaluation starts only on eligible bars after the signal timestamp.
execution_contract.historical_quote_limit: Current historical OHLCV/TRADE_VALUE/NBSS corpus does not prove exact historical L1 bid/ask or queue fills; proxy execution must be labelled as such.
execution_contract.friction: Buy fee, sell fee, observed tick/price-step proxy and any declared slippage buffer must be included explicitly.
execution_contract.no_entry: Candidate may become NO_ENTRY/SKIP when executable price runs away, structure deteriorates, or remaining net reward is insufficient.

research_decision_rule.keep: A behavior path may survive only if its performance remains directionally and economically defensible across multiple development months and multiple day/time/condition buckets.
research_decision_rule.replace: If a path is structurally weak across conditions, create a new behavior topology or combination. Do not rescue it solely by repeatedly moving numeric thresholds.
research_decision_rule.parameter_change: Parameter research remains permitted only to measure robustness around an already defensible topology, not to manufacture isolated historical fit.
